crossRefs.note: He doesn’t preserve the life of the wicked, but gives justice to the afflicted.
He also opens their ears to instruction, and commands that they return from iniquity.

translations.web: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression.
translations.bsb: God rescues the afflicted by their affliction and opens their ears in oppression.
translations.kjv: He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression.
translations.asv: He delivereth the afflicted by their affliction, And openeth their ear in oppression.
